provenance.source: JPL Horizons fixed 2026-09-03 epoch. Illustrative ICRF north pole (right ascension 0 degrees, declination +90 degrees), arbitrary prime meridian and phase. Chiron has no measured spin pole. The published ring or disk pole near ecliptic longitude 151 degrees, latitude +20 degrees is a pole of the surrounding material; the shape paper assumes the body shares it, and this display does not adopt that assumption as an orientation.
provenance.qualification: Computed Chiron Sun direction at 2026-09-03T00:00:00 TT, expressed in the ecliptic presentation frame (north up, Sun left at zero yaw) and in view space at the default camera pose.
